summary: Builds a 4x4 affine matrix at a1 (16 floats): zeros the off-diagonal and translation-row entries, sets the scale on the diagonal (a1[0], a1[5], a1[10]) to a2 and the homogeneous element a1[15] to 1.0. When the flag a4 is set it invokes an indirect transform thunk; if an offset vector a3 is supplied it subtracts the offset before the transform and adds it back after, otherwise the transform thunk is still called. Finally, if a5 is supplied, its three components are added to the translation row (a1[12], a1[13], a1[14]). Returns the matrix pointer.

local_names.a2: uniform scale applied to the diagonal
local_names.a3: optional offset vector subtracted before and added back after the transform
local_names.a4: flag controlling whether the transform thunk path runs

operations.description: Zero the off-diagonal and translation-row entries: a1[1], a1[2], a1[3], a1[4], a1[6], a1[7], a1[8], a1[9], a1[11], a1[12], a1[13], a1[14] = 0.0
Set the diagonal scale entries: *a1 (offset +0x0) = a2, a1[5] (offset +0x14) = a2, a1[10] (offset +0x28) = a2
Guard on flag a4: when nonzero the transform thunk path runs
Call ThunkToIndirectCallViaDAT005d7860 (0050D857) inside the a4 branch
Guard on a3 being non-null inside the a4 branch
Subtract the offset vector from the translation row: a1[12] (offset +0x30) -= *a3; a1[13] (offset +0x34) -= a3[1]; a1[14] (offset +0x38) -= a3[2]
Call ThunkToFUN0050cba3 (0050CBB0) after the offset is subtracted (a3 non-null branch)
Add the offset vector back to the translation row: a1[12] (offset +0x30) = *a3 + a1[12]; a1[13] (offset +0x34) = a1[13] + a3[1]; a1[14] (offset +0x38) = a3[2] + a1[14]
Call ThunkToFUN0050cba3 (0050CBB0) in the a3 null branch, with no offset applied
Guard on a5 being non-null: when set, its components are added to the translation row
Add the a5 vector to the translation row: a1[12] (offset +0x30) = *a5 + a1[12]; a1[13] (offset +0x34) = a5[1] + a1[13]; a1[14] (offset +0x38) = a5[2] + a1[14]
Return the filled matrix pointer a1
